page.overview:
Who is Daphne Beaumont?

Daphne Beaumont is the theater critic for the Springfield Shopper. She and the other critics Jamie Killday and Garth Trelawny influenced Homer to give bad reviews to restaurants similar to themselves. She is also seen in the mob about to chase Homer.
